description: ESP32 I2C master write timeout due to missing pull-up resistors
serial_logs:
I (201) i2c_example: I2C initialized
E (1201) i2c_example: I2C write failed: ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT
E (2201) i2c_example: I2C write failed: ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT
E (3201) i2c_example: I2C write failed: ESP_ERR_TIMEOUT
user_question: Why does I2C write keep timing out?
expected_root_cause: I2C pull-up resistors disabled in code (GPIO_PULLUP_DISABLE) and likely missing external pull-ups
expected_fix: Enable internal pull-ups: .sda_pullup_en = GPIO_PULLUP_ENABLE, .scl_pullup_en = GPIO_PULLUP_ENABLE, and verify external 4.7k pull-ups

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Enable internal pull-ups: GPIO_PULLUP_ENABLE; ensure external 4.7k pull-up resistors on SDA/SCL

expected_serial_log_events.likely_cause: Missing I2C pull-up resistors - bus stuck low or floating
expected_serial_log_events.suggested_action: Enable internal pull-ups in code; verify external 4.7kΩ pull-ups on SDA/SCL with multimeter

expected_follow_up_required: Check ESP32 datasheet for I2C pull-up requirements and internal pull-up strength
